meta.title: GenesisRAG17 knowledge pipeline
meta.event_bus: No event bus. Runtime domain events and an outbox are declared as the target taxonomy but not implemented (ARCH-001 §15). Every asynchronous hop is a durable database-backed ledger or queue that a worker ticks or claims (LineConversationJob, KnowledgeIngestion, PipelineRun/PipelineStep, GenesisRag17Batch), a relay through MSP, or evidence reported/pulled over authenticated HTTP. The three EVT contracts are deployment-authenticated worker ticks (EVT-002 LINE conversation worker, EVT-003 rich-menu worker, EVT-001 nightly retention sweep), not pub/sub topics.

nodes.label: Knowledge console / Files browser
nodes.detail: Owner admits an immutable Text/Markdown body or an existing readable FileAsset (UI, API or MCP — one admission service).

nodes.label: SmartGift catalog file
nodes.detail: Structured-record source (SMARTGIFT_CATALOG_V1) split into one record per catalog entry before Stage 1; CRM-shaped records denied twice.

nodes.label: LINE conversation (consent-granted)
nodes.detail: What a Business learns from LINE feeds back only as a reviewed, locator-only Q/A candidate — never a transcript.

nodes.label: LINE OA Studio published copy
nodes.detail: A published rich menu, LIFF app or bot profile's human-readable copy becomes a withdrawable TEXT source.

nodes.label: External providers (webhook · pull · file · manual)
nodes.detail: Every acquisition channel converges on one raw ingestion envelope; LINE webhook events, marketplace listings and retail prices arrive this way.

nodes.label: Curated document intake (business knowledge)
nodes.detail: Second pipeline definition on the same ledger (DPL-SUPABASE-BUSINESS-KNOWLEDGE-V1): document → approval gate → business_knowledge rows.

nodes.label: Source admission service
nodes.detail: One UI/API/MCP entry; idempotent on request key; same source version with changed content conflicts instead of overwriting.

nodes.label: KnowledgeCandidate review
nodes.detail: OWNER or LINE OA publisher approves a drafted Q/A; approved candidate is admitted as one immutable TEXT source.

nodes.label: Raw ingestion envelope → RawExternalRecord
nodes.detail: tenantId, connectionId, provider, lane, entityType, externalId, sourceType (PULL/WEBHOOK/FILE/MANUAL), payload verbatim as evidence.

nodes.label: Knowledge gap report
nodes.detail: Unanswered LINE questions (NO_EVIDENCE) aggregated per Business; never enters the corpus.

nodes.label: Stage 1 · Raw capture → KnowledgeRawArtifact
nodes.detail: Byte-identical record of the source, linked to the integration domain's RawExternalRecord; bytes in the object store.

nodes.label: Stage 2 · Parsing → KnowledgeParsedArtifact
nodes.detail: Pure calculator; structure, text_blocks, tables, warnings, extractor version. Structured sources use the genesisrag17-parser-2 profile.

nodes.label: Stage 3 · Provenance validation
nodes.detail: Validates and walks the ten-field provenance record (traceToSource); never mints provenance.

nodes.label: Stage 4 · Normalization
nodes.detail: Canonical forms alongside raw values.

nodes.label: Stage 5 · Classification (sensitivity lattice)
nodes.detail: PUBLIC / INTERNAL / CONFIDENTIAL / RESTRICTED plus processing policy (cloud_processing_allowed, embedding_allowed…). Decides per object where later stages may run; restricted content stays local.

nodes.label: Stage 6 · Deduplication
nodes.detail: Duplicate / revision / independent against held artifacts, within one tenant only (never cross-tenant).

nodes.label: Stage 7 · Chunking → KnowledgeChunk
nodes.detail: Retrieval-sized chunks with parent-child lineage, heading_path, token_count, scope, provenance.

nodes.label: Stage 8 · Entity-candidate extraction → SourceMention
nodes.detail: Mention plus type guess only; canonical identity is GKS Stage 9's authority. One GenesisRag17Batch per attempt.

nodes.label: Quarantine (BR-067 envelope)
nodes.detail: A per-stage failure is classified retryable / non-retryable / review-required with the complete failure envelope.

nodes.label: KnowledgeIngestion (durable queued job)
nodes.detail: One durable queued ingestion per authorized source version; idempotent on request key.

nodes.label: PipelineRun / PipelineStep ledger
nodes.detail: Append-only run/stage/record/gate evidence for every pipeline definition (DPL-KNOWLEDGE-INGEST-V1 with 17 DPS-KI-* stages). Owned by DOM-INT, read by consoles.

nodes.label: Object store (SRV-006)
nodes.detail: Admitted source bytes and catalogue objects through a provider-neutral storage port.

nodes.label: GenesisRag17 intent · batch · evidence cursor · receipt
nodes.detail: Durable source-worker intent, one batch per attempt, the pulled Tier 3/4 evidence cursor and the imported publication receipt. Execution records, never canonical facts.

nodes.label: business_knowledge (curated, RLS)
nodes.detail: Raw-SQL Postgres table behind forced row-level security; allow-listed public/curated product projection; no live operational facts.

nodes.label: Worker bridge (data_pipeline.* MCP tools)
nodes.detail: run_create · document_stage · event_record · monitor_read · replay_request, EVIDENCE_ONLY; no service-role key.

nodes.label: MSP relay (Tier 2)
nodes.detail: The sole gateway from Tier 1 to Tiers 3–4; stdio child process or relay; session lifecycle, episodic memory, vault gates, tool ceilings.

nodes.label: External-tier evidence · report + pull
nodes.detail: GKS/GenesisBlockDB report Stage 9–17 evidence with the Tenant's data-plane key; because GKS never calls outward, Zuri also pulls evidence by cursor.

nodes.label: Stage 9 · Entity resolution (GKS)
nodes.detail: Canonical entity identity — the authority Stage 8 never claims.

nodes.label: Stage 11 · Ontology mapping (GKS)
nodes.detail: ontology_v2 predicate vocabulary for catalog facts (HAS_COMPONENT, PRICED_AT, IN_CATEGORY).

nodes.label: Stage 13 · Graph construction → GenesisBlock native store
nodes.detail: GKS decides; the GenesisBlock worker performs the physical graph writes. SRV-004 is the only process holding the native store.

nodes.label: Stage 14 · GKS knowledge decision
nodes.detail: The specification names Stages 9–14 as GKS authority but does not name Stage 14 individually.

nodes.label: Stage 15 · Embedding (worker)
nodes.detail: Only where the object's processing policy allows embedding.

nodes.label: Stage 17 · Publication gate (GKS)
nodes.detail: PASS / PASS_WITH_WARNINGS publish; QUARANTINE / FAIL do not. Every result is a PipelineGateDecision on the ledger.

nodes.label: Published knowledge snapshot (per source)
nodes.detail: Atomic, identified publication (knowledge_snapshot_id, ontology_version, pipeline_version); a half-built index is never exposed.

nodes.label: KnowledgeCorpusGeneration manifest
nodes.detail: Tier 1 immutable, append-only manifest joining exactly-verified Stage 17 receipts per Business (+ optional Project) corpus.

nodes.label: Corpus query + citation resolution
nodes.detail: Pins one manifest, asks MSP for each active source's exact snapshot, fuses per-snapshot ranks (reciprocal-rank fusion), resolves citations against current ACL.

nodes.label: LINE answer (Agent context composer)
nodes.detail: Grounding mode per account (BUSINESS_KNOWLEDGE default · GKS_CORPUS · GKS_THEN_BUSINESS_KNOWLEDGE); every hop traced; no model call when no evidence.

nodes.label: Knowledge console readers
nodes.detail: Source library, run evidence per stage, corpus generations, generation-bound cited search.

nodes.label: Edge desktop (SmartGift)
nodes.detail: Reads the published generation through MSP (off / shadow / primary), never a private store.

nodes.label: Data Pipeline Map + live health overlay
nodes.detail: Meta view over the ledgers; executes nothing.
